AGENTS.md

Package Overview

R package with an Rcpp/C++ backend computing bivariate Moran’s I (spatial cross-correlation) as a function of Gaussian kernel bandwidth, producing a functional curve I(h) rather than a single value at one chosen scale. Implements the method in the companion preprint “multiScaleAC: Cell-Cell interaction with Moran’s I as a function of kernel bandwidth” (bioRxiv 2026.07.14.738306).

The R package is named multiScaleAC, matching the manuscript. The repository and local directory remain KernelCommunication, because that is the URL printed in the paper. Both names are correct in their own scope; do not “fix” one to match the other.

Non-negotiable rules

  1. R/soupir_moran_multi.R is the reference implementation and must never be modified. It is the regression oracle: every fixture in tests/testthat/fixtures/ is generated from it, and a test hashes it to detect edits. soupir_moran_multi() also stays exported permanently for backwards compatibility — it is not deprecated.
  2. RcppExports.R, RcppExports.cpp, NAMESPACE and man/*.Rd are generated. Never hand-edit them. Run Rcpp::compileAttributes() after any C++ change, then roxygen2::roxygenise().
  3. Work is local only. Never push to a remote.

Key Commands

R CMD INSTALL .                     # build and install
R CMD check --no-manual .           # run during development
R CMD check --as-cran .             # release gate
Rcpp::compileAttributes()           # after any C++ change (reads DESCRIPTION -- rename first)
roxygen2::roxygenise()              # regenerate .Rd and NAMESPACE
testthat::test_local()              # run the test suite

Note: devtools is not installed in this environment (its curl dependency needs system libcurl headers). Use the base R CMD tooling and testthat::test_local() directly rather than devtools::install() / devtools::test().

Structure

  • R/
    • soupir_moran_multi.R — reference implementation, never modify
    • soupir_moran_bv.R — single-bandwidth sparse variant
    • multi_scale_ac.R — multiScaleAC(), the main entry point
    • classes.R — S4 kernelcomm_result class and validity
    • significance.R — permutation p-values, multiple-testing correction
    • moments.R, approx.R — exact analytical permutation moments and tail approximations
    • methods.R, plot.R — show/print/summary/plot and the plot_* functions
    • helpers.R — input validation, bandwidth suggestion, neighbourhood QC
    • export_mxfda.R — bridge to mxfda::add_summary_function()
    • utils.R — sparse matrix conversion and lag operations
    • data.R — documentation for the ccRCCExample dataset
    • RcppExports.R — generated, do not edit
  • src/ — C++ (RcppEigen)
    • moran_kernel.cpp — tiled two-pass multi-bandwidth core
    • gauss_kernel_weights.cpp — sparse weight matrix from a Gaussian kernel
    • sparse_dense_mult.cpp — sparse-dense multiplication
    • Makevars, Makevars.win — OpenMP flags via $(SHLIB_OPENMP_CXXFLAGS)
    • RcppExports.cpp — generated, do not edit
  • tests/testthat/ — suite pinned to the reference implementation, with fixtures
  • data/, data-raw/ — packaged ccRCCExample dataset and its preparation script
  • process_docs/ — development notes from earlier design rounds. Treat them as historical: they predate the current compute core and inference code, and some describe behaviour that no longer exists. Build-ignored, so they do not ship in the package.
  • inst/validation/ — benchmarks and the approximation calibration harness
  • plans/ — implementation plans

Bandwidth units — the most common error in this package

ccRCCExample coordinates are in millimetres: they span 1.02 × 1.02 mm with a median nearest-neighbour distance of 0.0073 mm. The manuscript’s bandwidth range of 10–250 is in micrometres, i.e. h = 0.01 to 0.25 in this dataset’s units.

Using h = 10 or h = 25 here makes every off-diagonal Gaussian weight ≥ 0.9999 and the mean row sum over 7119 of 7122 cells — the kernel becomes a constant matrix and Moran’s I collapses toward zero. Earlier validation in this repository did exactly that, which is why it appeared to pass while testing nothing. Always sanity-check mean(rowSums(K)) against N before trusting a result, and use suggest_bandwidths() rather than hard-coding numbers.

Dependencies

R >= 3.5, Rcpp (>= 1.0.13), RcppEigen (LinkingTo), Matrix, methods, ggplot2, stats, utils, parallel. Suggested: testthat, knitr, rmarkdown, mxfda, PearsonDS.

Main Functions

  • multiScaleAC(coords, gene1, gene2, h, perms, ...) — main entry point; returns an S4 kernelcomm_result
  • multiScaleAC_batch(data_list, ...) — many samples, optionally in parallel, with checkpointing
  • compute_significance(result, ...) — p-values, z-scores, null envelope, supremum test
  • adjust_pvalues(result, method) — multiple-testing correction
  • export_mxfda(result) — data frame for mxfda::add_summary_function()
  • suggest_bandwidths(coords, ...), qc_neighborhoods(coords, h) — bandwidth selection and QC
  • soupir_moran_multi(coords, gene1, gene2, h_vec, perms, seed) — reference implementation
  • soupir_moran_bv(h, coords, gene1, gene2, perms, eps) — single bandwidth, sparse
